title: Polish magical working animating a golem, then Nazi tanks

tellings.quote: I was doing the magical working, she said, in a in Poland in the 1930s

plain: A woman at a party in New York is said to have told the writer Whitley Strieber that in the 1930s she took part in a magical ritual in Poland to bring a golem to life, a creature of clay from Jewish folklore, and that the story then turned to Nazi tanks. Strieber relays it as what she told him, and the tale also touches on China and the American general Joseph Stilwell. If true, it would mean ritual magic was being used in the run-up to the Second World War.
